minutes.title: Conceptual Design Meeting Minutes
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed the conceptual design of a remote control, finalized decisions on materials and features, and decided to leave out voice recognition. Next steps include market research for attachment feature and touch controls.
decisions: We decided on leaving out the voice recognition.
We will check into the financial feasibility of incorporating voice recognition feature
The design should be inspired by fruit colors like red chili and tomato.

actions.task: Add an attachment feature to the closing feature
Do market research on adding a kinetic feature
Discuss alternative designs like a flip top shell with customizable circuits.
Consider adding features such as an advertising display when the shell is opened, and touch controls for buttons.
Make a decision about battery type (kinetic charging vs. double/triple A batteries)
wrap up meeting, discuss remaining topics
